data.title: Amwell Receives Frost & Sullivan's 2026 United States Technology Innovation Leadership Recognition for Technology-Enabled Care Platforms
data.description: Amwell® is revolutionizing telemedicine with its unified Amwell Platform, integrating interoperability, clinical coordination, and intelligent management to enhance access, productivity, and results. On September 4, 2026, in SAN ANTONIO, these advancements were announced.

data.title: Rho Launches Card Payments on Invoices, Letting Businesses Accept Credit Card, Debit Card, and Google Pay
data.description: Customers of Rho Invoicing now have the capability to receive credit card payments on invoices, along with ACH and wire transfers, all from their existing bank account. This new feature allows for seamless syncing of invoices to QuickBooks Online. This update was announced on September 4, 2026, in New York.

data.title: Statement From U.S. Postal Service Postmaster General David Steiner Regarding Concerns About Ballot Mail for Federal Elections
data.description: On September 4, 2026, in Washington, there was a clarifying statement regarding the Postal Service's actions in line with Executive Order 14399. Addressing misinformation and speculation, the focus was on the role of the Postal Service in handling ballot mail for federal elections. The importance of adhering to the policies outlined in the executive order was emphasized in this clarification.

data.title: Dynamic Automotive Hosts 18th Annual Car Show to Benefit Habitat for Humanity of Frederick County
data.description: In Frederick, Maryland, on September 4, 2026, Dynamic Automotive is excited to reveal details about its 18th Annual Car Show. This special community event aims to exhibit classic and custom vehicles and generate funds for the chosen charitable cause of the year, Habitat for Humanity of Frederick County.

data.title: BMO Completes Sale of 138 U.S. Branches to First Citizens Bank
data.description: Today, BMO Financial Group (TSX: BMO) (NYSE: BMO) finalized the sale of 138 branches to First-Citizens Bank & Trust Company. The branches are located in North Dakota, South Dakota, and other regions as previously disclosed. This transaction marks a significant development in the banking sector, with important implications for both companies involved.

data.title: Royalty Pharma announces update on Novartis’ Phase 3 topline results for pelacarsen
data.description: Royalty Pharma plc (Nasdaq: RPRX) announced today that Novartis' Phase 3 results from the HORIZON outcomes trial for pelacarsen, an antisense oligonucleotide, were shared. The trial, focusing on patients with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease and elevated lipoprotein(a) (Lp(a)), did not reach its primary goal of decreasing the risk of cardiovascular events in the overall study group compared to a placebo. These events include cardiovascular death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, non-fatal stroke, and urgent coronary revascularization requiring hospitalization. Novartis plans to disclose the Lp(a) HORIZON trial data at an upcoming medical conference.

data.title: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacifico Reports a Passenger Traffic Increase in August 2026 of 0.5% Compared to 2025
data.description: Mexico-based Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacífico, S.A.B. de C.V. revealed its preliminary terminal passenger traffic data for August 2026 versus August 2025. The company, listed on NYSE as PAC and BMV as GAP, announced these figures from Guadalajara.

data.description: On September 4, 2026, in Portage, Michigan, it was announced that Stryker (NYSE:SYK) will be attending the 2026 Wells Fargo Healthcare Conference on September 8, 2026, at the Encore Boston Harbor. data.title: Eirion Risk Underwriters Launches New Inland Marine Program
data.description: Eirion Risk Underwriters has introduced a new Inland Marine program in Roswell, Georgia. The program boasts a wide appetite for coverage, offering up to $25 million in capacity. Additionally, clients will have direct access to underwriters for quick and efficient service.

data.title: ErieView Development Closes $218 Million in Financing for W Cleveland at Erieview Tower
data.description: ErieView Development has recently secured funding amounting to $218 million for the conversion of Erieview Tower in Cleveland. This iconic 40-story building, constructed in 1964, will be transformed into the W Cleveland hotel, which will feature 210 rooms, making it the first W Hotel in Ohio. Additionally, the building will offer 215 W Apartments for rent, marking the brand's first rental residential project globally. The projected opening for the hotel and residences is set for late 2027. This development boasts an extensive amenity program, promising a luxurious living experience for residents and guests alike.

data.title: Ameribrands Acquires Randal Retail Group, Expanding National Design, Manufacturing and Installation Capabilities
data.description: Ameribrands, based in Ball Ground, Georgia, a diversified company serving various sectors including restaurant, retail, hospitality, entertainment, education, and facilities, has acquired Randal Retail Group. Randal Retail Group is a prominent provider of retail design, fixture manufacturing, merchandising displays, and installation services. Through this acquisition, Ameribrands enhances its retail capabilities and progresses towards establishing a premier national platform.

data.title: Viridian Metals Announces Closing of Non-Brokered Private Placement and Market Making Agreement with Independent Trading Group
data.description: Viridian Metals has recently finalized the closure of a non-brokered private placement. The company also established a market making agreement with Independent Trading Group. This move enables Viridian Metals to raise significant funds for its operations. The private placement saw a total investment of approximately $2 million from various investors. This strategic partnership with Independent Trading Group is expected to enhance the market presence and liquidity of Viridian Metals' shares.

data.title: Questor Technology Reports Progress on Execution of Phase III Shareholder Value Creation Plan
data.description: On September 4, 2026, Questor Technology Inc. provided an update on its Phase III shareholder value creation plan, following its announcement on August 17, 2026. The company, listed on the TSX-V as QST, has made significant advancements as part of its strategy refresh during a management transition in Q2 2026. Questor's rental fleet is prepared for use, with commercial operations progressing in North America, Africa, and the Middle East. Additionally, a key partnership in Mexico is paving the way for a potential enterprise-wide contract with Pemex. These developments signify promising growth opportunities for Questor Technology Inc.

(TSXV: CNVI) (OTCQB: CNVIF), a company specializing in medical devices for minimally invasive cardiovascular procedures, revealed partnerships for media and digital marketing. data.title: Lawsuit filed against Tether for $42M frozen coins, 6,600 students receive crypto loans; Thai businessmen sue over pig scam. Aussie firms face hefty fines if licensing deadline not met.
